newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/29a51de8460d9ebb11602464b315956cb4a50c31.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell: 50+ Guaranteed Rewards!*[/h2][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass is packed with 100+ Rewards, including a brand-new catch-up system that guarantees 50+ rewards in the Battle Pass*. In addition to the normal unlocking of Battle Pass content, players who fall behind in the Battle Pass will be automatically caught up to the Reward matching the current day of the season, up to day 50.[/p][p]*Requires a paid Battle Pass.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b0506a20b29af07e0247eff0182d716754bfb6fe.jpg"][/img]The Battle Pass itself is easier to navigate: Log in to collect your rewards and keep playing to unlock an easy-to-follow 100-tier track filled with additional Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Finishing Moves, Calling Cards, Weapon Charms, Reticles, and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]How Do I Purchase the Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Battle Pass?[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b54c023733b3e10be8c5d1a5a8a00a1088149d29.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass in one of four different ways:[/p][list][*][p][b]Battle Pass:[/b] For 1,100 COD Points, receive access to the Season 1 Battle Pass.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Battle Pass Bundle:[/b] For 2,400 COD Points, receive access to the Season 1 Battle Pass, plus 20 Tier Skip Tokens.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]BlackCell:[/b] Purchase BlackCell, and you automatically receive access to the Season 1 Battle Pass, plus 20 Tier Skip Tokens, as well as all earnable BlackCell content and other rewards detailed below.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Vault Edition:[/b] For players who purchase the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition, in addition to all the other Vault Edition rewards, you gain access to all BlackCell and Battle Pass content, providing you log into the game during Season 1.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]How Does the Modern Warfare 4 Battle Pass Work?[/h3][p]The plan is straightforward: Simply play [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Multiplayer, DMZ, or [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i]™, earning XP as you go, which levels up your Battle Pass from Tier 1 through 100.[/p][list][*][p]Simply earn Tiers through playing the game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Battle Pass owners also receive a 10% Battle Pass XP Boost for the entire season, as a reward for purchasing the Battle Pass.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Optionally use Tier Skip Tokens with COD Points to instantly claim any unlocked rewards.*[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Optionally use Battle Pass 2XP Tokens you’ve acquired to quicken progress throughout the Battle Pass. Active XP Tokens are paused outside of matches.[/p][/*][/list][p]Auto Catch-up: Players who fall behind in the Battle Pass are automatically caught up to the Tier reward matching the current day of the season, up to day 50.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dbaee6eedf8f60ecd81dc9fd4f8efc45f486989f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]*Tier Skip Tokens:[/b] Tier Skip Tokens allow you to access higher level rewards in the Battle Pass, unlocking content ahead of the next tier on the track. Players who purchase the Battle Pass Bundle can use their Tier Skip Tokens to access any of the 10 unlocked tiers ahead of their current position, while BlackCell users can grab rewards from up to 20 tiers ahead. Spending a Tier Skip Token on a higher tier reward will not change your in-progress position on the Battle Pass.[/p][p][/p][h3]What Type of Battle Pass Rewards Do I Earn?[/h3][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass features 100+ pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new (and free) Base Weapons, and more, including new items such as DMZ Survival Kits. Expect to unlock the following as you progress through the Battle Pass:[/p][list][*][p]New Base Weapons[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Charms[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reticles[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Emblems[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Calling Cards[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Double XP Tokens (Player and Weapon Tokens)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Blueprints[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Finishing Moves[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Stickers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Equipment Skins[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Loading Screens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Decals and Stickers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sprays[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Survival Kits[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bonus Rewards (arriving mid-season; see later in this blog)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Season 1 BlackCell Offerings[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/777834124e8c33a70530ef87936e35125c88b9bf.jpg"][/img][/h2][p]The BlackCell faction is now active across all theaters of operations. BlackCell users will gain instant access to the “XERO” Skin and Operator, one of a trio of BlackCell Agents arriving in Season 1 under the name XERO. Complete BlackCell challenges to access two other XERO Skins: “Cowled” and “Adder.” The clandestine XERO leads a team of additional Operators clad in Skins and carrying Weapon Blueprints earned through BlackCell. [/p][p][/p][h3]Vault Edition Owners: BlackCell Access Granted![/h3][p]If you obtained the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition, you can unlock this season’s BlackCell offering. [/p][p]If you obtained the Digital Standard Edition of Modern Warfare 4, you can upgrade to the Vault Edition at a later date, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details"]unlocking the many Vault Edition benefits detailed here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]What Type of BlackCell Rewards Do I Earn?[/h3][p]BlackCell owners get access to multiple rewards within the Season 1 Battle Pass, including:[/p][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Operator Skins for Blix (two Skins), Oh-Ji, Velikan, Min-Hee, Luca, and Dallas.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Weapon Blueprints for the Kastov 762 Assault Rifle, Axion Assault Rifle, KG-7 Vulcan Sniper Rifle, ISO Nightshade SMG, CSG-35 SMG, Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle, and the Mosin-Nagant Marksman Rifle.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]BlackCell Multiplayer Lobby: Select any Operator from the BlackCell Faction, and your MP Lobby changes to the “Enigma Bunker”, reflecting a Black Site location within the faction’s operating facilities.[/p][/*][/list][p]Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.[/p][p][/p][h3]BlackCell DMZ Benefits[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e6965f6a66e27dbcf81df57ddcc137ababd22d65.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Gain extra benefits in DMZ as a Season 1 BlackCell user, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]FOB:[/b] Extra Vendor Weapon and Equipment Slots: The Vendor in the Forward Operating Base (FOB) carries an additional weapon for purchase, and up to four pieces of Equipment, available to BlackCell. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Daily Rewards:[/b] Every 24 hours, a new reward — such as Printer Ingredients like Rigid Synthetics — will arrive in the FOB.0020These items are available to BlackCell users. Note that these rewards do not stack; any uncollected reward is lost when the next day’s reward cycles in, so visit the FOB BlackCell Bunker entrance daily to acquire your maximum quotient of rewards. Access the rewards at the DMZ Bunker, which are automatically deposited into your survival kit menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]FOB Visual Upgrades:[/b] Players who own BlackCell will see upgraded tent materials and visuals throughout the FOB. The upgraded structures will remain visible as long as the player owns BlackCell.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]BlackCell Weapon Manuals:[/b] For each BlackCell Weapon Blueprint you earn in the Battle Pass, you unlock the ability to craft the Blueprint’s base weapon in the DMZ Gunsmith.* [/p][/*][/list][p][b]*DMZ Weapon Manuals[/b] are also granted in the following two instances:[/p][list][*][p]When you [b]first unlock a new season’s free Base Weapons within the Battle Pass[/b] (in this case, the Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle and the CSG-35 SMG).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you purchase a [b]Store Bundle with a Weapon Blueprint[/b], a Weapon Manual for the base version of the Blueprint is also acquired.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]All other Blueprints[/b] you secure (for example, via the Battle Pass or a Store Bundle, whether you own BlackCell or not) allow you to use the Blueprint in DMZ until you fail to exfil with it, after which you can rebuy the Blueprint at a discount.[/p][p][/p][h2]Battle Pass Initial Access: Instant Rewards[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3738c31cb161c6709ff649b788f541ce538484ab.jpg"][/img][/h2][p]No matter how you obtain the Season 1 Battle Pass, you gain access to the new catch-up system described above and immediately unlock the following Instant Rewards:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d2c6e00217cd073936642422ee08e60bdfd44988.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]10% Battle Pass XP Boost for the duration of Season 1[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Up to 1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Downpour” Operator Skin for Blix (shown above) and “Downpour BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Fortune’s Favor” FiNN LMG Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Happy Boom” Frag Grenade Lethal Equipment Skin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Killing Demon” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: “Ballistic Gel Armor Kit” DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]BlackCell Initial Access: Instant Rewards[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e48bcf6ce64f6839b3a85146e3cfcada9cd54913.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Purchase BlackCell to immediately unlocks a variety of Instant Rewards, kicking off your season on a high note with access to the following items:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d922913e02961065fb0fe7a9b7ee145e27a2676.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The “XERO” BlackCell Operator plus the “Cowled” and “Adder” Operator Skin variants available via BlackCell Challenges[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Perimeter Lance” M4 Assault Rifle Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint the “Occultus” and “Exitium” additional Signature Weapon Blueprint variants available via BlackCell Challenges.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dog Food” Companion Finishing Move, along with Dog Pet Companion that appears with your Operator in the Multiplayer Lobby when this Finishing Move is selected. Expect the dog to appear in the DMZ FOB at mid-season.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]MP: The Custom “Enigma Bunker” BlackCell Lobby Scene[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]BlackCell Mastery Camo Track (see below)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]20 Tier Skip Tokens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “BlackCell” Call Sign Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and during Match After Action Reports)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: “Advanced Triage Kit” DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Operator Skin and Weapon Blueprint Challenges[/h3][p]Expand your BlackCell Agent roster and Blueprint collection by completing in-game challenges to unlock two additional XERO Operator Skins and two additional M4 Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprints. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b7133828aac02b128fa5b28eb16ba5acb17fc738.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Track your challenge progress in-game and complete the following challenges:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Challenge One: Kills[/b][/p][p]Reward: “Cowled” Operator Skin for XERO and “Occultus” M4 AR Blueprint[/p][p]Criteria: Obtain 3,000 Points.[/p][list][*][p]MP: 1 Kill = 5 Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: 1 Kill (Enemy or Operator) = 2 Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: 1 kill = 15 Points[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Challenge Two: Victories[/b][/p][p]Reward: “Adder Operator Skin for XERO and “Exitium” M4 AR Blueprint[/p][p]Criteria: Obtain 100 Points.[/p][list][*][p]MP: 1 Match Win = 10 Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: 1 successful Exfil = 20 Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: 5 kills without dying = 10 Points[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6f175b4675d4c7c85bc71aa5e19811c3edfeede.jpg"][/img][b]BlackCell Camo Track:[/b] Access the Season 1 BlackCell Mastery Camo track, offering additional BlackCell Weapon Camos for BlackCell users who complete various in-game weapon challenges.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Challenge Three: Weapon Camos[/b][/p][p]Reward: Six Weapon Camos[/p][p]Criteria: Complete the Challenge for each Weapon Camo. After completion, the Weapon Camo can be applied to any weapon. Complete the following with any weapon within the class:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Assault Rifles Reward: “Infiltrator” Camo[/b][/p][list][*][p]MP: Get 10 double kills[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Get 20 triple kills  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: Get 25 kills with ground loot[/p][/*][/list][p][b]SMGs Reward: “Cell Ops” Camo[/b][/p][list][*][p]MP: Get 20 point-blank Place 1st on the scoreboard 3 times[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ: Exfil with over 150 kills 5 times[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]WZ: Get 2 kills within 10 seconds 10 times[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fe54e074533e62aef52c086a0fa5495becf8160b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]BlackCell Bonus: Extra Daily Challenges:[/b] As well as the BlackCell “Enigma Bunker” Lobby, accessed in Multiplayer when a BlackCell Agent is selected, and a Pet Companion when the “Dog Food” Finishing Move is selected (shown above) BlackCell owners additionally get access to additional Daily Challenges throughout Season 1 for Multiplayer and Call of Duty: Warzone. BlackCell Daily Challenges count toward the three challenges required to earn Daily Challenge Bonus XP.[/p][p][/p][h2]Season 1: Main Battle Pass and BlackCell Operators[/h2][p]Get more intel on featured Season 1 Operators Blix and XERO, who both excel in the art of stealth and precision.[/p][p][/p][h3]Blix (Battle Pass, Launch)[/h3][p][i]Battle Pass Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/663e713dd333a166773992ecdd870c6dc18f6726.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A former South Korean Special Warfare Command operator, Blix was captured during a covert border mission and held for years. After surviving imprisonment, he was transferred through a network of foreign captives and deployed into proxy conflicts.[/p][p]War reshaped his view of combat into an absolute doctrine. He began tattooing survival codes and tactical principles across his skin, turning himself into a living archive. His mechanical efficiency and indifference to pain drew the attention of masked mercenary leader Nikto, who recruited him as a premier operative. Now in the Exclusion Zone, Blix carries out each objective with silent, disciplined precision.[/p][p][/p][h3]XERO (BlackCell, Launch)[/h3][p][i]BlackCell Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9db769ab74821cfab0c0b581407011f71b07b318.jpg"][/img][/p][p]BlackCell has no record of XERO before a classified development program involving behavioral conditioning, synthetic identities, and experimental combat training. His designation traces back to X-0, an internal prototype number later replaced by a single name: XERO.[/p][p]Field personnel describe him as unnervingly controlled, with flashes of memory tied to places and people absent from his official history. BlackCell refuses to explain them. Some believe his identity was erased; others suspect he was assembled from failed subjects. One theory is more disturbing: BlackCell created XERO’s past where none existed.[/p][p]Now deployed when an operation requires complete deniability, XERO remains one of BlackCell’s most closely controlled assets.[/p][p][/p][h2]Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell: Content Deep Dive[/h2][p]Here’s all the Intel you need related to the types of Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell rewards:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d4fc5f5fb22d50b17d8e076019c4e9ca62e8998a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Battle Pass: New Base Weapons[/h3][p]Down targets with lightning speed with two new Battle Pass base weapons that bring the highest fire rate to their respective weapon classes: the Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle and the CSG-35 SMG.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Primary Weapon: Cronen Osprey (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Tier 16, Tier 87 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cf3b2fc5b0b3776b7e3bfb262d9b138986767e49.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 70[/p][p][b]Rounds:[/b] 30[/p][p][b]Reserve:[/b] 90[/p][p][b]Fire Rate:[/b] 882 RPM[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Battle Pass.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Ammunition, Magazine[/p][p][/p][p][i]Precision-engineered for relentless performance, this 5.56 rifle delivers a best-in-class fire rate without sacrificing control, accuracy, or mobility.[/i][/p][p]Featuring the fastest fire rate in its weapon class, the Cronen Osprey chews up enemy targets fast while maintaining accuracy on target so long as you’re able to counter its recoil kick up and to the right. Use burst fire and Attachments that improve vertical recoil control to help stay on target and consider a higher round Magazine if you find yourself running through your ammo reserves too quickly.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: Cronen Helix Mk.II[/b][/p][p][i]A unique double-barrel receiver transforms this 5.56 rifle into a dual-fire weapon platform. Firing on both trigger pull and release, it delivers punishing damage with an unmatched rate of fire among semi-automatic weapons.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Primary Weapon: CSG-35 (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]SMG, Battle Pass Tier 36, Tier 73 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c8d77300a77f83ac45019cf284f739af86d07bea.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 42[/p][p][b]Rounds:[/b] 28[/p][p][b]Reserve:[/b] 112[/p][p][b]Fire Rate:[/b] 1200 RPM[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Battle Pass.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Ammunition, Magazine[/p][p][/p][p][i]A highly mobile conceal-and-carry SMG that pairs maneuverability with a best-in-class rate of fire. Fast, compact, and lethal in tight spaces.[/i][/p][p]Another rapid-fire option that beats out the other SMGs in spitting out rounds, the CSG-35 is the perfect tool for clearing enemy targets up close. Use its strong mobility and handling characteristics to get into position fast and let loose with a blazing attack. Ideal for breaching and flanking tactics that bring you toe to toe with the enemy. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: CSG Crossfire[/b][/p][p][i]Dual-wield akimbo CSG-35 SMGs and trade accuracy for a wave of downrange chaos.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Battle Pass and BlackCell Operator Skins[/h3][p]In addition to multiple skins for main Battle Pass Operator Blix, and main BlackCell Operator XERO, the following Operator Skins are available:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Oh-Ji “Nocturn” paint designed to blend in with the underbrush.[/p][p][/p][h3]Battle Pass and BlackCell Weapon Blueprints[/h3][p]In addition to the Weapon Blueprints unlocked as part of the BlackCell and Battle Pass newsitems.title: Российская 1w выиграла "Московские киберигры 2026" по Counter-Strike 2 и обеспечила себе место на мейджоре
newsitems.contents:
В Москве завершился международный турнир по Counter-Strike 2, ставший одним из главных событий II Московской международной недели видеоигр. Впервые с 2019 года столица приняла соревнование такого уровня, результаты которого учитываются в официальном рейтинге Valve Regional Standings (VRS).

За выход в финальную часть турнира боролись 956 команд из 31 страны, а решающие матчи прошли в Московском кластере видеоигр и анимации. Главный трофей достался российской 1w, которая в финале оказалась сильнее HOTU.

На первой карте, Anubis, 1w одержала победу со счётом 13:9. Вторая карта, Dust2, получилась значительно напряжённее. HOTU сумела отыграться с 4:8 и сравнять счёт до 11:11, однако два заключительных раунда остались за 1w. Итоговый результат — 13:11 и победа в серии со счётом 2:0.

Этот успех оказался особенно важным из-за сроков проведения турнира. Финал состоялся непосредственно перед обновлением рейтинга Valve, определяющим приглашения на PGL Major Singapore 2026, PGL Cluj-Napoca 2027 и BLAST Bounty 2027 Season 1.

Благодаря победе 1w обеспечила себе место на мейджоре в Сингапуре сразу со второй стадии, а также получила приглашения на два других крупных соревнования. Для HOTU поражение стало серьёзным ударом по турнирным перспективам: команда упустила гарантированное приглашение на мейджор и теперь конкурирует за оставшееся европейское место с fnatic и 100 Thieves.

Примечательно, что капитан 1w Владислав nafany Горшков и тренер Константин groove Пикинер уже добивались крупных успехов вместе. В 2021 году они выиграли престижный IEM Katowice в составе Gambit.

Третье место на «Московских кибериграх» заняла монгольская The Huns Esports, обыгравшая соотечественников из 5star eSports со счётом 2:1. За ходом соревнования следили сотни тысяч зрителей на площадке и в онлайн-трансляциях.

Финал проходил в Московском кластере видеоигр и анимации, открывшемся в ноябре 2025 года. По словам руководителя Агентства креативных индустрий Москвы Гюльнары Агамовой, организаторы рассчитывают проводить международные киберспортивные турниры на этой площадке регулярно.

newsitems.contents: [p]x[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2f527078fecf9e9bcb681652e0e82254b78300af.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Call of Duty: Warzone Season 1: Declassified[/h2][h3]Overview and Roadmap[/h3][p][/p][p]With the arrival of Season 1 in [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i], players will get their hands on new Multiplayer maps and modes, a new area, bosses, and other bonus content in DMZ, plus new weapons, attachments, and more. For full details, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/677387230220656499"]check out our Season 1 deep dive into Multiplayer and DMZ[/url].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="iOfYGojxFE0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Season 1 also features a major update to the free-to-play [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i]™, including full integration with [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. Read on for all the details you need regarding Season 1 in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], including intel on the new Hajin and Zodiac maps, new gear like the Zipline Launcher and Grabber Drone, Elite Perks, and more. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b45e485dc99504ebbf3b404ad5c36ab74d42bb64.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The Season 1 Roadmap featuring all new content arriving in Call of Duty: Warzone.[/i][/p][p]Prepare for an escalation of warfare when Call of Duty: Warzone [b]Season 1 goes live at 0000 (midnight) ET on November 6 (2100 PT on November 5)[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]Call of Duty: Warzone: Welcome to the Hajin Conflict[/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Season 1 Integration:[/b] Season 1 fully integrates Modern Warfare 4 into Call of Duty: Warzone, introducing a fresh leveling experience, an influx of new weapons, new gameplay mechanics, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Battle Royale Map – Hajin:[/b] Explore the massive Hajin Battle Royale map, bringing Call of Duty: Warzone to South Korea for the first time in a region narratively linked to the Modern Warfare 4 Campaign.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Resurgence Map – Zodiac:[/b] Drop into the new Zodiac Resurgence map, a compact combat zone built around the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly and manufacturing headquarters.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Gameplay Features:[/b] Dig into the major gameplay features arriving in Season 1, including new gear like the Zipline Launcher and Grabber Drone, new interactive objects like moveable fuel barrels and pushable cover, Grind for Royalty, Weapon Augments, Ground Ops, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Modes:[/b] At Season 1 launch, drop into Battle Royale and Resurgence, including Casual variants for each, as well as Rally Point, Massive Resurgence, and Loaded Resurgence. In the Mid-Season, modes expand with the introduction of Extreme Resurgence and Rockets and Snipers.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Perks:[/b] Get a full list of all the Perks that will be available starting in Season 1, including info on the new Elite Perks.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Equipment:[/b] See the revised selection of Tactical and Lethal Equipment items that will be available to equip to your Loadouts, as well as new and returning Field Upgrades and Killstreaks.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Vehicles:[/b] Whether traveling by land, water, or air, there’s a vehicle for you. Check out the full array of vehicles on offer starting in Season 1.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Mastery Camos:[/b] Show off your dedication to the grind with intel on Call of Duty: Warzone Mastery Camos.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Full Integration with Modern Warfare 4[/h3][p][/p][p][i]What’s changing in Season 1 of Call of Duty: Warzone?[/i][/p][p]With the integration of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], Season 1 brings major updates to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Expect the following at launch on November 6:[/p][list][*][p]Player Level reset, allowing you to level up and optionally Prestige across Multiplayer, DMZ, and Call of Duty: Warzone.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Access to all 33 Modern Warfare 4 launch weapons, plus the additional armaments coming to Season 1, each featuring Weapon Prestige and specific Call of Duty: Warzone Mastery Camos to unlock.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Apex Attachments.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Season 1 Operators.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Daily Challenges.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Calling Card Challenges.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Battle Pass and BlackCell progress.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/36746fe7b9686845e44d3c70fca7915f41ba10c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Other changes include gameplay adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Tactical Sprint will be available to all Operators without the need for a Perk, but its duration is slightly shortened.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Players can drag their allies while reviving them, pulling them out of harm’s way.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional weapon balance tuning.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved visibility and readability across all maps.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved footstep audio.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes"]Look for the Season 1 Patch Notes on the Call of Duty Blog[/url] for more details.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Carry Forward, Legacy Weapons and Content[/b][/p][p][i]How will Carry Forward and Legacy Weapons work in Season 1?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a1cab2bca79126d0465e870ce27d922ea1d8346d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Operators, Operator Skins, and Weapon Blueprints, as well as Calling Cards, Emblems, Operator Finishing Moves, Emotes, Sprays, Parachutes, and Contrails from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i], [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], [i]Black Ops 6[/i], and [i]Black Ops 7[/i] will be available in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] starting in Season 1. With the new Operator Skin Toggle, you will have more control over the Operators Skins you see in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] only. [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/09/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-warzone-season-1-operator-toggle"]Check out our article on the new Operator Skin Toggle[/url] feature for more info.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/83783937168aafa1e76c8d1b5c15464cbd0db214.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] weapons provide the full weapon experience, while all weapons from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] through [i]Black Ops 7[/i] will continue to be accessible in the Legacy tab of the Loadout menu. [/p][p]Legacy Weapons are still usable, but cannot be edited in Gunsmith and do not support the following [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] features:[/p][list][*][p]Mastery Camos[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reticle Challenges[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Customization[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Cosmetic Gunsmithing[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Build Sharing & Build Codes[/p][/*][/list][p]Legacy Weapons won’t be left as base Weapons without Attachments. Instead, a five-attachment version of each Legacy base Weapon will be available, as well as any Blueprint for a Legacy Weapon with their existing Attachment setups. These Legacy Blueprints will all initially be locked and available to unlock through Player XP in the Armory.[/p][p] [/p][h3]New Battle Royale Map: Hajin[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c574eccf9a8f362e84353de8a8bd062b0d77c944.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For the first time, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] will feature action along the Korean Peninsula as players deploy to Hajin, a new largescale map that connects Battle Royale to the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] narrative.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a2f3f0b638d097ed84b42a4c7dc7e4c5c6ecb94f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For a detailed look at the region, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/10/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-dmz-deep-dive-hajin#Tour"]check out our DMZ Tour of Hajin[/url], offering a guided walkthrough of the region’s major Points of Interest, from the coastline to downtown and the wilderness beyond. While DMZ players will feel right at home in Hajin, there are some notable differences between the DMZ version of the map and the Battle Royale version. This includes how the encroaching Edge Circle and Gas moves throughout a match, a lack of radioactive cloud at the Hanuel Nuclear Reactor, the available Vehicles, and the distribution of interactable objects, as well as loot caches across the map.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like to check out the Tac Map for Hajin, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/dmz-maps/hajin"]click here[/url].[/p][p]If you’d like to a tour of all POIs on Hajin, [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/10/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-dmz-deep-dive-hajin#Political"]click here[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Battle By the Border[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5d9dbaeccfd6ec21df3a85a627b856e127ad3f24.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In Hajin, Operators will battle in both North and South Korea across 13 major POIs. Navigate crowded city streets, abandoned buildings, open farmland, winding rivers, and forested hills, creating different combat opportunities depending on where you land. [/p][p]Hajin City’s central districts feature towering buildings, barricaded roads, and heavily fortified locations, rewarding squads that coordinate their movements and secure advantageous positions. Rural areas such as Imjin Farmland offer more exposed terrain, where long-range engagements and careful use of available cover are essential for survival.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e5e1f33fac9dcc4d8c1e46fe19c9d65510fe7a96.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over the border, the setting shifts as Operators approach North Korean locations such as the 14th Political Prison, Chang-san Air Base, and Deadtown.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weather Scenarios[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/232a991efee647bbe32b9145ef81feee935772e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect to run into variable weather patterns in your deployments to Hajin, adding a layer of unpredictability to each match. From clear skies to fog, wind, rain, and distant storms, localized weather patterns change the look and feel of the environment. With this in mind, the development teams have put in a lot of effort to ensure that no matter what weather you encounter, visibility remains a central factor in gameplay. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Hajin Gulag[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/42da7ecd17f7d873e22f32370fb7134ff2afe66a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A new Battle Royale map means a new Gulag. When you first get eliminated in Battle Royale, you’ll have the chance to earn your redeployment back into the match... so long as you can defeat the enemy in a 1v1 matchup. [/p][p]Eliminated Operators will be sent to one of two versions of the Hajin Gulag. Enter as a spectator including ground level views for the first time, and when it’s your turn to fight for your life, deploy to the central arena. [/p][p]The two variants feature a different set of cover objects within a small, rectangular space in a symmetrical layout. In one, partial walls line the perimeter over open ground while the other includes sturdier features with a number of small sheds over a flagstone walkway. Both versions are exposed to the elements and will be affected by local weather patterns, adding variety to your visits here.[/p][p]You can mantle on a good deal of the obstacles, encouraging aggressive movement throughout the area. Win the duel to deploy back into the match. Lose and you’re out.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Resurgence Map: Zodiac[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3c865e13f350db58df178594f85a154ce3e3a7a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Experience Resurgence on the all-new Zodiac, a compact combat zone built around the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly and manufacturing headquarters in South Korea. Zodiac combines sprawling factory interiors, research facilities, elevated rooftops, underground tunnels, and coastal terrain to create a diverse combat environment.[/p][p]The map’s ten distinct Points of Interest each offer different opportunities for combat and squad rotations. Key locations include Admin, the central administrative tower; Trackline, where trains travel across a double railway that cuts across the facility; and Furnace, an industrial area built around heavy manufacturing equipment. Other locations, including Solar, Old Mines, Dispatch, Depot, Sentinel, Cooling, and R&D, provide additional options for looting, ambushes, and establishing defensive positions.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Underground Routes, Environmental Hazards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d79a609919dda7d474d6ab5cb54ccb63ba3c241.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Experience Resurgence on [b]Zodiac[/b], an all-new battleground set within the DRC Advanced Systems drone manufacturing headquarters in South Korea. More than just an industrial complex, Zodiac is an environment shaped by conflict, where damaged facilities, sprawling factories, research labs, and underground passages create a battleground filled with stories to uncover and opportunities for combat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/43bcdc7a491be29289983278995013fc139a4b2f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Across ten distinct Points of Interest, every location brings a different way to fight. Battle through Admin's towering offices, navigate the heavy machinery of Furnace, or explore the research facilities of R&D. Other locations, including Solar, Old Mines, Dispatch, Depot, Sentinel, and Cooling, offer opportunities for looting, flanking, and outmaneuvering enemy squads. From tight interiors to elevated rooftops, the map's interconnected environments keep players adapting their strategies.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Underground Routes, Moving Trains, and Environmental Hazards[/b][/p][p]At the heart of Zodiac, Trackline's double railway system and moving trains add an unpredictable layer to the action. Underground tunnels let squads slip beneath the battlefield and emerge from unexpected angles, while interactive elements like moving solar panels, furnace conveyor belts, and explosive fuel barrels create new ways to turn the environment to your advantage.[/p][p]Developed by Beenox in close collaboration with Infinity Ward, Zodiac builds on the team's experience creating iconic Call of Duty: Warzone locations such as Rebirth Island and Vondel. Combining layered level design, dynamic environments, and a distinct South Korean setting, Zodiac delivers a fresh Resurgence experience where every match offers new opportunities to move, engage, and outsmart opponents.[/p][p][/p][h3]Returning Battle Royale Map: Verdansk (In-Season)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f397450732f6d2c03d6f2e671e0e852b0110b406.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Verdansk returns later in Season 1, its familiar skyline now punctuated by the Signal Station, the Grazna-7 Launch Complex, Overlook skyscraper, and the high-tech Drone Labs. From frozen forests and industrial sprawl to dense city blocks, Verdansk brings newer landmarks and new reasons to revisit this classic [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] map.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/80036f66f14ecef3d23378a132b015ff178a3a49.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Returning Battle Royale Map: Rebirth Island (In-Season)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/41f546f6a5fd6176379278085c6e39fe670ddf99.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Rebirth Island also returns in Season 1, bringing its close quarters fights back across the prison, control center, and surrounding industrial compounds. With repurposed infrastructure and familiar routes, navigable waterways, and hidden passages, offer there’s always a place to drop rival Operators across this compact and classic Resurgence map.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Gameplay Features (Launch)[/h3][p][i]Which new gameplay features are coming to Call of Duty: Warzone in Season 1?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Field Upgrade: Zipline Launcher[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/81a8e0cf44742cfa3f13cff736ff5539e2460424.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Overcome large obstacles and flank from rooftop to rooftop with ease using the Zipline Launcher. Aim and fire the device to create anchors and a zipline that can be used to scale high points and zipline across the terrain. Once deployed, the Zipline Launcher will remain active on the map until it’s either retrieved or destroyed. [/p][p]The entire squad can use it, including enemy Operators, so be aware of its placement and whether you’ve got enemies on your tail. If you notice a zipline being created by another squad near your position, check the line for incoming enemies. Work with your squad to make the most out of these interactive objects, setting up new cover positions, roadblocks, explosive traps, and more. Strive for new personal records and get rewarded with two new Weapon Camos (one static, one animated) each season. newsitems.title: Bungie раскрыла сроки возвращения контента в Destiny 2 - не раньше 2028 года
newsitems.contents:
В начале этого года Bungie объявила о прекращении работы над крупными обновлениями для Destiny 2, что выглядело как финал. Однако в прошлом месяце студия заявила о возвращении всех скрытых кампаний шутера. Теперь руководитель отдела продуктов Джош Дин в блоге Bungie изложил текущее состояние процесса.

Первый этап восстановления контента, доступный всем игрокам, направлен на то, чтобы вернуть целостность всех кампаний. В него войдут:

кампании «Красная война», «Заброшенные», «Проклятие Осириса» и «Военный разум»;

набеги, рейды и логова рейдов из этих кампаний;

активность «Зверинец» с обновлёнными наградами.

Дин отметил, что «Зверинец» занимает особое место в сердцах команды, и сообщество годами просило вернуть его.

Работа над извлечением контента из хранилища началась в июне с оценки целесообразности. Сейчас это подготовительный этап. Полномасштабное производство, как ожидается, начнётся не позднее февраля 2027 года и займёт около 12 месяцев. Таким образом, вернуться к этим дополнениям можно будет не раньше 2028 года.

Команда также изучает «дополнительные цели», которые могут появиться вместе с разблокировкой контента или позже:

локации для свободного перемещения;

сезонные активности от Sundial (9-й сезон) до The Coil (32-й сезон);

обновления оружия для рейдов и логов рейдов;

карты для PvP.

Bungie намекает на более масштабные планы, включая «празднование» после «Момента триумфа» с «новыми обновлениями» и нечто под названием «Наследие Destiny». В блоге говорится: «Наше эпическое путешествие началось более десяти лет назад, и весь этот опыт должен быть предоставлен вам там, где вы играете сегодня. Ожидайте больше информации, когда мы вернёмся к вам в начале следующего года». Это звучит как намёк на оригинальную Destiny, но к таким заявлениям стоит относиться с осторожностью.

Также упоминается загадочное «Засекречено» с сообщением запуска Ventrilo: «Мы вернулись». Что это значит, пока неизвестно.

Основной посыл блога: Bungie «строит новое будущее для Destiny», так что проект не заброшен. Следующее крупное информационное сообщение ожидается в феврале.

newsitems.title: Bungie Community Update – October 2026
newsitems.author: Destiny2_Team
newsitems.contents:
[p]Welcome back to the blog. It’s been a while.  [/p][p]We’re trying something new today, even if it feels a bit familiar. Since our [url="https://www.bungie.net/7/en/News/Article/nextchapterofbungie"][u]“Next Chapter of Bungie” video and blog article[/u][/url], we’ve been thinking about ways to keep the conversation rolling. Maintaining a transparent heartbeat of updates with you all is pivotal for the success of our studio. As such, we’re spinning up a new “Bungie Community Update” blog to keep in touch as we head into the future. 
 
To be clear, this isn’t going to become a weekly series like a TWID/TWAB. Rather, this will be a general space for us to give updates on our studio. Sometimes we’ll talk about Destiny, other times Marathon, and every so often we may just chat about general Bungie news that needs more space than a social media post. We want to make sure that whenever we speak with you there’s a human tone and a takeaway, so we’ll want to take appropriate amounts of time between entries to get you real, meaningful news. In other words: A Bungie Community Update is never late, nor is it early; it arrives precisely when it means to. [/p][p]We're also exploring more ways to get you updates on the fly. Marathon side, we’ve started a string of Dev Insights leading into Symbiosis and the March Update. These take a bit of time to film and produce, so we’re also looking into smaller, more casual spaces to have discussions. Podcasts? Livestreams? AMAs? We’ve done many of these in the past, but we need to rebuild some bones to get them up to speed again. I could talk on and on about our comms pillars and how we’ll keep chatting as we move forward into the next chapter, but I know what you’re all here for. Video games. More specifically, Bungie video games. 
 
For October, we’re moving forward with a mainstay of Bungie: A nice ol’ blog. Today we have [url="https://x.com/S14deane"][u][b]Josh Deane[/b][/u][/url][b] (Head of Product)[/b] here to run through some Q&A about Destiny & Unvaulting, give some context on where the studio is at right now, and talk about what’s to come. Many thanks to all who’ve been sending questions our way over the last few weeks, we hope to cover many through the answers below. [/p][p] [/p][h2]Every End is a New Beginning [/h2][p][b]Welcome to the hot seat, Josh. To start, let’s set the stage. What are we focusing on today?[/b] [/p][p][b]Josh: [/b]Well, if you can’t stand the heat... [/p][p]I figure, let’s just have a conversation about where we’ve been and where we are on our new journey together. So, we’ll cover what ‘wholeness’ means for Destiny’s legacy, and how we’re working to reimagine Destiny’s future. [/p][p]Most importantly, we need to talk about how we intend to rebuild a relationship with you all, not just simply announce a future for a cheap win.  [/p][p]To do that I think we have to rewind the clock a bit before Monument of Triumph heading into our end of service announcement for Destiny 2. [/p][p][/p][h2]Rage Against the Dying of the Light [/h2][p][b]What was the experience like heading into Monument of Triumph and watching the community respond the way they did? [/b] [/p][p][b]Josh: [/b]I think I’m not alone in saying the months leading into the end-of-service announcement for Destiny 2 were as difficult a time as we’ve ever experienced. I know personally, seeing a world that was a home to players and us about to be put in stasis, shrouded in darkness with an unknown future, knocked me out. Like many of you if you’re reading this, Destiny has been my shelter, but that is probably another story for another time. [/p][p]Heck, there is also probably a future ‘Ted Talk’ about the complex journey that led to the moment of Destiny 2’s end of service announcement, but regardless of all the ‘whys’ it fails to take the sting out. It was really Poria \[good friends' rule] who picked me up off the mat, and we made the decision as we took on new roles that no matter what challenges were left to overcome, Destiny, Marathon, and Bungie were going to be different going forward.  [/p][p]Dylan, you probably remember this like it was yesterday. It started by changing the opening of the Monument announcement and comms at the last minute. Regardless of how impossible, it was necessary for that moment to not be a funeral; it had to be a battle cry. Basically, light the beacons and hope Rohan would answer. And you all did.  [/p][p]You all didn’t just rage; you showed up. You shared your stories about your memories in Destiny, what the world meant to you and made sure to petition how disastrous it would be to walk away from this amazing universe. It inspired everyone. [/p][p][b]Dmg04: [/b]Oh, I remember. I will never forget. Seeing how players rallied after that End of Service announcement, how passionate they were... and how they’re still showing up daily asking about our shared future? It will live with me forever. They did not go gently... [/p][p][/p][h2]Restoring Destiny and our First Step [/h2][p][b]Speaking of players asking questions... since the unvaulting announcement, we’ve seen healthy discussions and questions about the decision. Why are we starting with unvaulting?[/b] [/p][p][b]Josh:[/b] I just don’t see how we could move forward with confidence without first repairing trust and making Destiny 2 ‘whole.’ Spoiler, I don’t see that wholeness intent just as unvaulting content; it means restoring Destiny’s past, present and future, but let’s start with unvaulting.  [/p][p]The vaulting of essential Destiny 2 content, even if based on some real technical challenges, was a moment that fragmented our experience and broke faith with our community. And strategically, as we incubate a new future for Destiny, we need to serve you all along the way with meaningful updates to our universe.  [/p][p][b]What are we starting with? In our "Next Chapter of Bungie" comms, we noted Campaigns, Destinations, and Raids specifically. What else is on the table? [/b] [/p][p][b]Josh:[/b] Our first pass for unvaulting, available to all players, focuses on getting our campaign slate whole again. We're specifically targeting the activity content of Campaigns, Strikes, and Raids from vaulted expansions. Menagerie holds a special place in our hearts (and we've seen years of community requests for a return), so it will be a part of this pass as well:  [/p][list][*][p]Red War, Forsaken, Curse of Osiris, and Warmind campaigns [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Strikes from the above releases [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Raids, and Raid Lairs from the above releases [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Menagerie Activity with reprised rewards [/p][/*][/list][p]Beyond this first pass, we're also investigating content that we're defining as stretch goals at unvaulting launch or after. For example, we know aspirational content like legacy Raids needs a deeper chase even if we may not able to address it upfront. As we get closer to unvaulting we’ll be able to provide stronger insight into these areas: [/p][list][*][p]Free Roam Destinations (Public Events, Lost Sectors, Escalation Protocol, etc.) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Seasonal Activities from Sundial (Season 9) to The Coil (Season 23)  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Raid and Raid Lair Weapon updates [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]PvP Maps [/p][/*][/list][p]Our final section currently does not have a path to update either for technical and/or strategic reasons. As we're looking to build the future of Destiny, we need to find balance. While we'd love to bring back some additional activities, or refresh things like our New Light experience, it could come at a cost for what we want to build for you in the future:  [/p][list][*][p]Updated New Light Experience [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Seasonal Story Missions [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gambit Map (Kell's Grave) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Seasonal Hubs (e.g., Eliksni Quarter) [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Many have been asking how long this will take. What's the current status? Many have been asking where we're at terms of a timeline.[/b] [/p][p][b]Josh: [/b]Where are we? Let’s talk about that [b]progress bar[/b].  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35190912/efd98a40b8520870abbbe093399e138b204a8f81.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]In June, we secured our initial greenlight to begin scoping the work, validating we could do it and finding a partner to help us make it real.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In September, we validated our assumptions and then raced to tell you all. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Right now, we are in our pre-production, proof-of-work stage where we will ensure the process is working and hitting our quality bar as we port the legacy content.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We expect this part of the process to last until roughly January/February. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]From that point we [i]expect[/i] full production will be about [b]12mos[/b]. to fully complete the porting process. It’s a lot of content.   [/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2]What’s next? [/h2][p][b]In the Next Chapter of Bungie video, you mentioned that we’re “not done with Destiny” - what more is on the horizon? [/b] [/p][p][b]Josh: [/b]Ok, this is the part of the conversation where I need to [b]start talking about intent, even when knowing some things are subject to change in success or failure[/b]. Similar to June, when we aligned our initial greenlight with Destiny 2 unvaulting and fully greenlit the project in September, we’ve also aligned a new vision and plans for Destiny all up that we are actively working on making a reality.  [/p][p]We are marching forward with a phased plan for Destiny’s future that celebrates our legacy and propels us into a [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O_FmqI7QKck"][u]new, far green country.[/u][/url]  [/p][p]These are our anchors to look for and what will become future progress bars when we’re successful:  [/p][list][*][p][b]Destiny 2 “Celebration’’ \[Expect a new February Progress bar] [/b][/p][list][*][p]We believe we need to have a celebration in Destiny 2, beyond Monument of Triumph, for the community that provides [b]new [/b]updates for you all to enjoy. More details to come! [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Destiny ‘Legacy’ \[Expect a new February Progress bar] [/b][/p][list][*][p]Our epic journey started over a decade ago, and the [b]whole [/b]experience needs to be served to you all where you play today. Expect more information when we come back to you all early next year.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Redacted \[TBD][/b][/p][list][*][p]Launch Ventrilo Message: ‘We’re back’[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Once we get through this incubation, validation process, we’ll have earned the right to make the announcements you all deserve. And if not, exile. I’ll be a good high school football coach somewhere.[/p][p][b]Dmg04: [/b]Ah, \[REDACTED]. Always love when we use that. As for the progress bars, these differ a bit from roadmaps – more general and high level, but we'll still be planning to provide updates on the status of each project as information becomes available. As we continue to build trust with the community in our future, transparency is key. And the promise of these progress bars is one we intend to keep. [/p][p][/p][h2]The Future and what to expect [/h2][p][b]With our unvaulting initiative serving as a form of incubation for Bungie, how exactly [i]does[/i] this process work?[/b] [/p][p][b]Josh:[/b] I think before we close it’s important to know that this is a true reset moment for Bungie, Marathon, and Destiny. We also know time isn’t our friend; we’re playing from behind with the cards we have and I’m sure we’ll have to take more punches and make some hard decisions along the way.  [/p][p]Let’s talk a bit about the process more and why it’s not simply, just put all of your resources right here, right now.  [/p][p]Going to be overly reductive, but this is a simple rule; the wider the innovation, the new frontiers to explore, the smaller a team needs to be early on in a project. You have to spend time in discovery, concepting, research and development, scoping, and feasibility analysis before you scale. Forcing a large team into this kind of process creates chaos and crushes it from a production perspective. In success, you have a project that has gone through this process and is ready to scale by the time we're able to holistically allocate resources to it. [/p][p]Now, the ‘opposite’ is true in well-defined or clearly benchmarked spaces. For example, if we were doing something in Destiny 1 or 2, we can work at speed with different sized teams and partnerships because we have clear boundaries on how to accomplish our goals and understand our resource constraints. The challenge is here that your opportunity cost and overall ceiling of a project may not allow you to bring all the resources to bear that you would like. TLDR: The constraints may be tighter.  [/p][p]Knowing both of the above states are true in our current world is the puzzle we’re working through for how we get to our end game, a new, forever Destiny, while rebuilding a relationship with a vibrant community along the way.  [/p][p]So, knowing we are early in incubating our future and actively working on projects to bridge us to that new home, don’t expect us to make a Destiny announcement at the TGA’s this year, or to randomly drop a logo that sets the world on fire right away.  [/p][p]We get there when we get there.  [/p][p][/p][h2]See you again soon. [/h2][p][b]Well, it’s pretty clear we have a lot to get done over the next few months. Any parting thoughts you’d like to share with players before tackling the next challenge of the day?[/b] [/p][p][b]Josh:[/b] I think the main thing we should all be on the same page on is we have a steep mountain to climb. The challenges we face are real to forge a new path for Bungie. Its never been more important for our community to keep talking to us, to keep sharing your passion (and critiques) and to build each other up as one community.  [/p][p]At a high level though, the key things to remember today:  [/p][list][*][p]We’re on track for unvaulting Destiny 2 content  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We’re planning more for us to celebrate within the Destiny you know today [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We are aligned and are building a [i]new[/i] future for Destiny  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Targeting February for our next major comms update \[we’ll share unvaulting progress along the way] [/p][/*][/list][p]I'll stop rambling shortly. I think my last note is something really close to my heart, especially as I exist in both worlds. [/p][p]The Destiny and Marathon communities need to heal. [/p][p]We're not going to forget the mistakes of the past, but it's time to learn from them and unify as one Bungie community. For us, the majority of our Bungie team is legacy Destiny, and we will all tell you that nothing can help bridge us into future more than for Marathon to rapidly evolve and become sustainable. As we head into our December and March updates for Marathon, it’s a formative period for all of us here at Bungie that will help determine the shape of our future, so please encourage each other and know that your support gives our team the energy to finish the fight.  [/p][h2] [/h2][h2]We Shall Rise... [/h2][p]It's an exciting time for us as we're preparing Marathon: Symbiosis for launch in December while exploring the future of Destiny, all starting with our unvaulting initiative. As Josh mentioned, progress bar updates will come as they're ready, and we're planning our next major comms beat regarding Destiny for February. [/p][p]As for Marathon, expect our next Dev Insight to land in early December. We’re actually in the middle of filming more interviews about Symbiosis this week. It’s always a fun time hopping in builds to see how things are coming together, not to mention playtesting the upcoming experimental PvP mode. We’ll have some fun things to talk about in November, so stay tuned... 
 
As always, thanks for stopping by. We’ll see you again soon. [/p][p]Cheers, [/p][p]-dmg04 [/p]

The JAK 12 excels as a breaching tool; if you anticipate enemies on the other side of that closed door, barge through and tear them to shreds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: JAK Barrage[/b][/p][p][i]Launch a salvo of adhesive explosives that stick to surfaces and targets before detonating with devastating results.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Melee Weapon: ZLR Talonhawk (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e4f6f43722f442876e9b8dce57bee3313b746991.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 10[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges:[/b] Yes[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Event.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] None[/p][p]Attack foes with a variety of hacks and slashes using this deadly Combat Axe, its heft capable of inflicting heavy damage to the unlucky recipients of its blade. [/p][p][/p][h3]New: Weapon Attachments [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/137a7faf64751f92158dc1fe630908692c1f084b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hyeon Auto Apex Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Hyeon Burst Assault Rifle, Wager Match Event Reward[/i][/p][p]Converted to fully automatic fire, the Hyeon Auto was built for laying down stable, rapid fire. Offering a substantial increase in continuous RPM over the burst fire/semi-automatic variant, this weapon relies on firepower over precision.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kastov 545 Apex Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Kastov 762 Assault Rifle, Wager Match Event Reward[/i][/p][p]The Kastov 545 fires 5.45x39mm rounds, offering smooth handling and rapid follow-up shorts without sacrificing combat effectiveness.[/p][p][/p][p][b]M16 Burst Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]M4 Assault Rifle, Event Reward[/i][/p][p]Give the M4 the M16 treatment. Equip the M16 Burst Attachment to trade full-auto fire for controlled bursts. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Attachments (In-Season)[/b][/p][p]Adjust your weapon arsenal still further with more Attachments to unlock, including the TT Iron Guard Kit for the .50 GS Pistol, and the ChainSAW Grip set for the FiNN LMG.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 1 Events: Initial Intel (MP, DMZ, WZ)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/45ca91fa7d0fa10cefa7398b23d557f010ed0590.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Season 1 kicks off with the new Wager Match Event, plus additional Events as the season progresses. Participate and unlock an impressive array of rewards including new weapons, Weapon Attachments, Weapon Blueprints, Camos, Operator Skins, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Event: Wager Match (MP, DMZ, WZ)[/b][/p][p][i]Rewards Include: New Attachments, Operator Skin, Weapon Blueprint, Weapon Camo[/i][/p][p]Fight for top billing in the Wager Match Event*, where Trophies are the currency and collecting more of them earns valuable rewards including multiple Weapon Attachments. Enter the Gauntlet 1v1 Gunfight playlist in Multiplayer, and other challenges across DMZ and Call of Duty: Warzone.[/p][p]Compete for extra rewards if you’re one of the top three winners, and Mastery Rewards to chase along the way, including an Operator Skin, Blueprint, Weapon Camo, and multiple weapon Apex Attachments. [/p][p][i]*No money or items of real-world value are available by participating.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Events (In-Season, Mid-Season, MP, DMZ, WZ)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Camo Events:[/b] Play matches to earn XP and acquire Weapon Camos.[/p][p][b]Joint Fire Event:[/b] While you can go solo in this party up Event, there’s a big boost to your progress if you Squad Up. Bring in your Friends to activate an XP Boost that increases for larger squads, and unlock rewards including Blueprints, Charms, 2XP Tokens, a DMZ Survival Kit, and more.  [/p][p][b]Additional Events:[/b] Look for more events coming at Mid-Season.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell [/h3][p][b]Guaranteed Value and a New Streamlined Battle Pass System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/240b10bd61170c881c911a822a6fcff1dfa6c3c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass is packed with 100+ Rewards, including a brand-new catch-up system that guarantees 50+ rewards in the premium Battle Pass for those who purchase it. In addition to the normal unlocking of Battle Pass content, players who fall behind in the premium Battle Pass will be automatically caught up to the Reward matching the current day of the season, up to day 50. [/p][p]The Battle Pass itself is easier to navigate, too: Log in to collect your rewards and keep playing to unlock a linear 100-tier track filled with additional Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Finishing Moves, Calling Cards, Weapon Charms, Reticles, and more.[/p][p]Purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points or the Season 1 Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to gain access to the new catch-up system and to immediately unlock the Battle Pass Instant Rewards, including the following items:[/p][list][*][p]10% Battle Pass XP Boost for the duration of Season 1[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Up to 1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Downpour” Operator Skin for Blix (shown above) and “Downpour BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Fortune’s Favor” FiNN LMG Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Happy Boom” Grenade Lethal Equipment Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Killing Demon” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass features 100+ pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new (and free) Base Weapons, and more, including new items such as DMZ Survival Kits. Expect to unlock the following as you progress through the Battle Pass:[/p][list][*][p]New Base Weapons[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Charms[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Emblems[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Calling Cards[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Double XP Tokens (Player, Weapon, and Battle Pass)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Blueprints[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Finishing Moves[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Stickers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Equipment Skins[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Loading Screens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Decals[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kits[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Season 1 Battle Pass Completion Rewards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7bd5ece6469f0c794933d311ef87c4a6dbd312a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Players who purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass and complete all 100 tiers will earn the following completion rewards:[/p][list][*][p]The “Vantage” Operator Skin for Blix (shown above) and “Vantage BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Blue Viper” Hyeon Burst Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]200 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Honor’s Harbinger” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Virtue’s Snarl” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Ultra Weapon Blueprint Tier 100 Reward[/b][/p][p]And that’s not counting the Tier 100 reward itself, the “Bellum” Ultra rarity Mosin-Nagant Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bonus Rewards[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Later in the season, players who have purchased the premium Season 1 Battle Pass and completed all 100 tiers get the chance to unlock a special set of additional game rewards. For Season 1, there are eight additional Operator Skins you won’t want to miss! Stay tuned for more intel when the Season 1 Reloaded Blog drops.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BlackCell Offerings[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c40f66368ba28bd7121394d356824039e07697f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The BlackCell faction is now active across all theaters of operations. BlackCell users will gain immediate access to the first of a trio of BlackCell Skins for Agents arriving in Season 1 under the name XERO. The clandestine XERO leads a team of additional Operators clad in Skins and carrying Weapon Blueprints earned exclusively through BlackCell.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Vault Edition Owners: BlackCell Access Granted![/b][/p][p]If you obtained the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition, you can unlock this season’s BlackCell offering. [/p][p]If you obtained the Digital Standard Edition of Modern Warfare 4, you can upgrade to the Vault Edition later, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase, unlocking [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/705521410310669069"]the many Vault Edition benefits detailed here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Season 1 BlackCell[/b][/p][p]BlackCell owners can access the Season 1 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items:[/p][list][*][p]The “XERO” BlackCell Operator plus the “Cowled” and “Adder”Operator Skin variants available via BlackCell Challenges[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Perimeter Lance” M4 Assault Rifle Signature Weapon Blueprint plus the “Occultus” and “Exitium” Signature Weapon Blueprint variants available via BLackCell Challenges.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dog Food” Companion Finishing Move[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A Custom BlackCell Lobby Scene[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mastery Camo Track[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]20 Tier Skip Tokens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Pack[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and during Match After Action Reports)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]BlackCell owners get access multiple rewards within the Season 1 Battle Pass, including:[/p][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Operator Skins for Blix (two Skins), Oh-Ji, Velikan, Min-Hee, Luca, and Dallas.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Weapon Blueprints for the Kastov 762 Assault Rifle, Axion Assault Rifle, KG-7 Vulcan Sniper Rifle, ISO Nightshade SMG, CSG-35 SMG, Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle, and the Mosin-Nagant Marksman Rifle.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional DMZ Benefits, to be detailed prior to Season 1 launch.[/p][/*][/list][p]Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BlackCell Operator and Weapon Challenges[/b][/p][p]In addition to the Operator Skin variants for XERO, and the Signature Weapon Blueprint variants, you can unlock exclusive Universal Weapon Camos by completing BlackCell Camos. What exactly are these Camos? You’ll find out in the coming days![/p][p][/p][h3]Operators[/h3][p]Get more intel on Season 1 featured Operators XERO and Blix, who both excel in the art of stealth and precision.[/p][p][/p][p][b]XERO (BlackCell, Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]BlackCell Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3ce64bad7632ae525deffb3a04087c02899b0252.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There is no record of XERO before BlackCell. Not an erased record. Not a sealed record. Nothing. The earliest known reference to him appears inside a classified BlackCell development program involving behavioral conditioning, synthetic identities, experimental combat training, and neurological augmentation. [/p][p]Whether those skills were taught, implanted, or recovered from a life XERO no longer remembers remains classified. His designation originates from X-0, an internal prototype number found repeatedly throughout damaged BlackCell archives. Later documentation replaces X-0 entirely with a single name: XERO. [/p][p]Field personnel describe him as unnervingly controlled. He demonstrates familiarity with locations he has supposedly never visited and occasionally recognizes people who insist they have never met him. Certain sounds, symbols, and encrypted transmissions have triggered brief episodes of memory that do not correspond with anything in his official history. [/p][p]BlackCell refuses to explain them. Some within the organization believe XERO was a volunteer whose identity was deliberately erased. Others believe he was assembled from the remnants of multiple failed subjects. A more disturbing theory persists among those with access to the original program: BlackCell did not erase XERO's past. They created one where none existed. [/p][p]Today, XERO operates as one of BlackCell's most closely controlled assets, deployed when an operation requires complete deniability. No country can claim him. No agency can identify him. And if BlackCell's files are accurate, XERO may not know enough about himself to ever leave them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Blix (Battle Pass, Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Battle Pass Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7ee728f8beea1ca1f0167f0c398dc3c676e8ef02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A former elite operator within South Korea’s Special Warfare Command, Blix’s trajectory shifted permanently after a covert border mission led to his capture and extended imprisonment. Enduring extreme hardship, he survived the ordeal only to be funneled through a network of foreign captives and deployed into high-intensity proxy conflicts.[/p][p]On the battlefield, his perspective on combat transformed into a rigid, absolute philosophy. Blix began tattooing fragments of survival codes and tactical doctrine across his skin, turning his body into a living archive of warfare. His mechanical efficiency and complete indifference to physical trauma caught the attention of the masked mercenary leader Nikto, who pulled him from the ranks to serve as a premier operative. Now deploying into the Exclusion Zone, Blix executes his objectives with silent, disciplined precision, viewing the theater of war not as a duty, but as an absolute doctrine.[/p][p][/p][h3]Support Veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8a476c6255e16b23350b5a989f9c82daf5282b28.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Call of Duty players can support veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack in Season 1 of [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i]. Get the pack now![/p][p]Created in collaboration with U.S. Marine Corps veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter, the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack is inspired by his story of courage, sacrifice, and resilience. Players will discover details influenced by Kyle's military service, including his own mottos featured on in-game weapons and other elements that honor his story.[/p][p]One hundred percent of Activision’s net proceeds for this special item, less VAT/sales tax, will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. For those of you who don’t know, the Endowment helps U.S. and U.K. veterans find high-quality jobs after their service. Since their founding in 2009, they have placed more than 180,000+ veterans into great jobs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]USAA Giveaway for U.S. Service Members and Veterans[/b][/p][p]And once again, USAA, a leading financial services company for the military, veterans and their families, has teamed up with the Call of Duty Endowment to offer a free Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], to U.S. military service members and veterans. It’s just one of the ways we can say thank you for your service to our country.[/p][p]Once you click the link for redemption below, you will be redirected to an [url="https://www.xnow.com/embedded/flow/usaa-cod-military-verification"]XNow account sign-in page[/url] to claim your prize. [url="https://www.callofdutyendowment.org/sweepstakes"]See official rules.[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Verify Your Email, Unlock “Locked Down” Weapon Camo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/81ee798c48038aaa45f8002150a2b9125e43b172.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Unlock the “Locked Down” Universal Weapon Camo simply by verifying your email! Verifying your Call of Duty account email helps strengthen security. Once you complete this verification, prepare to receive the following, added to your Call of Duty Account:[/p][p]For more info on email verification, [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/activision-account-email-verification"]visit our Activision Account Email Verification FAQ here.[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 Today! [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0de45a72bf28b7c11ccdbf0ba91f145349fe84cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/Call_of_Duty_Modern_Warfare_4/"]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 on Steam today[/url] and stay tuned for all your [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel needs for Season 1 and beyond![/p]
