[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d897bb630fb567f1b11e928a2b353031645abb21.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare 4[/i] is now live worldwide! In the epic Campaign, Price is on the run, conflict has erupted on the Korean Peninsula, and a catastrophic weapon of war is on the verge of falling into the wrong hands. [/p][p]Deploy across 20 Multiplayer maps at launch, including 12 new 6v6 maps, 4 Gunfight maps, 3 Ground War maps, and the new Kill Block modular training facility. Experience grounded, precise combat built around fluid movement, player choice, and greater control in every engagement. [/p][p]In the DMZ extraction mode, operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every deployment into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out. [/p][p]Keep reading for all the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launch intel you need, so that you’re fully prepared to kick off an incredible Modern Warfare experience. Here’s what you should know:[/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Launch Comms[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a3008575ab81f3d6ed17d6da730896927f975cee.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What Do I Need to Know About Modern Warfare 4?[/h3][p][/p][p]Get up to speed on the major [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] beats:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/719041721925633150"]The Story So Far[/url] and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1938090/announcements/detail/683013558653419697"]Campaign Trailer[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278033470"]All Multiplayer Operators, Weapons, Equipment, and Create-a-Class Features[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278035866"]Multiplayer Maps and Modes[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278033531"]Progression and Prestige[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/714540024688805804"]DMZ Deep Dive Part 1: Tour of Duty – Hajin Environments and Threats[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/714540659097208825"]DMZ Deep Dive Part 2: How to Play – Forward Operating Base (FOB)[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/692021394394843423"]PC Trailer, Tech Updates, and More[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Unlock More with the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/381cdc27c05d5a93e83376c2a1b742a07de5ab03.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What Extra Content Does the Vault Edition Include?[/h3][p][/p][p]Purchase the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Vault Edition for even more premium content with an exceptional value, including bonus rewards available only through this edition. Secure the Vault Edition to gain access to all included content, rewards, and edition-specific benefits:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i][/b] Digital Edition[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hunter Killer Operator Skin:[/b] Gain access to the Hunter Killer Operator Skin.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hostile Alliance Operator Pack:[/b] Gain access to Operator Skins for Price, Valeria, Ghost, and Blix.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Special Forces Operator Pack:[/b] Unlock the Special Forces Operator Pack, including Operator Skins representing the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and South Korea, each with voice packs in their local languages.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Signature Weapon Collection:[/b] Flex your loadout with the Signature Weapon Collection, featuring five different Signature weapons equipped with multiple Attachments including an Apex Attachment, including:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Voltspine” Kastov 762 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“La Sombra Venenosa” (“The Poisonous Shadow”) ISO Nightshade SMG Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Shattered Code” Rezi 12 Shotgun Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Volt-Edge” Oris 8.6 Marksman Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Sombra Besada” (“Shadow’s Kiss”) Combat Knife Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]BlackCell* (One Season):[/b] Jump start your journey with BlackCell benefits including access to BlackCell content, the current Battle Pass, and up to 20 Tier Skips.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ Deployment Bonus:[/b] Get a head start in DMZ with the DMZ Deployment Bonus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Upgrade to the Vault Edition[/b][/p][p]If you pre-ordered the Digital Standard Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], you can upgrade to the Vault Edition at a later date, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase, unlocking the many Vault Edition benefits detailed above.
[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] Upgrade steps may vary by platform. Refer to your platform’s storefront for details.[/p][p][/p][h2]NEW: Support Veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="tTKfKjWpxmA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Starting today, support veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. The pack will be available at launch in Multiplayer and DMZ before it releases in Call of Duty: Warzone™ with Season 1. [url="https://www.callofduty.com/valor"]Get the pack now.[/url][/p][p]Created in collaboration with U.S. Marine Corps veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter, the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack brings the story you've seen throughout Forged in Valor into the game. Working closely with the Infinity Ward and Endowment teams, Cpl. Kyle (Ret.) helped shape a pack filled with personal references drawn from his life, service, recovery, and the mindset that continues to drive him forward.[/p][p]The Valor Pack includes the following in-game items:[/p][list][*][p]“Valor” Operator[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Relentless” Operator Skin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forged Resolve” M4 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Still Standing” Rezi 12 Shotgun Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Worth Fighting For” Combat Knife Melee Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Nice Try” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Steel Talon” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forged in Valor” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Earned, Not Given” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Blood, Sweat, & Sand” Loading Screen[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Level XP Token  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token [/p][/*][/list][p][i]"There are two types of courage: the courage to act and the courage to endure."[/i] – Kyle Carpenter[/p][p][/p][p]From phrases that have guided him through adversity to details inspired by real moments from his military journey, every item reflects the resilience, determination, and optimism that define his story.[/p][p]Among the items is Kyle's favorite, the "Nice Try" Weapon Charm, a playful nod to the humor, attitude, and resilience that have become part of his story. While the pack honors remarkable acts of courage, it also captures the mantras that continue to drive Kyle forward today.[/p][p]One hundred percent of Activision’s net proceeds will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. For those of you who don’t know, the Endowment helps U.S. and U.K. veterans find high-quality jobs after their service. Since their founding in 2009, they have placed more than 180,000+ veterans into great jobs. [/p][p][/p][p][b]USAA GIVEAWAY FOR U.S. SERVICE MEMBERS AND VETERANS[/b][/p][p]Once again, USAA has teamed up with the Call of Duty Endowment to offer a free Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], to U.S. military service members and veterans. It’s just one of the ways we can say thanks for your service in our country.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.xnow.com/embedded/flow/usaa-cod-military-verification"]Click here for redemption[/url] to be redirected to an XNow account sign-in page to claim your prize.[/p][p] [/p][p]Eligibility: U.S. active and former military members only. While supplies last. Quantities limited. XNow account required. See the official rules here.[/p][p][/p][h2]Link Your Discord Account[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/97f45a2683d2abd6ddd2b58d39f322f69782b499.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are adding new Discord features to [i]Call of Duty[/i]! By linking your account, you will have direct access to your Discord friends and have the ability to send invites directly from the game. As a thank you, players who link their accounts will receive a bonus Calling Card. newsitems.title: Bungie раскроет планы по возвращению контента в Destiny 2 на следующей неделе
newsitems.contents:
Bungie продолжает работать над возвращением контента, удалённого из Destiny 2 за прошедшие годы. Ранее компания заявила, что «не собирается останавливаться» и намерена сохранить наследие франшизы, начав с восстановления всего, что было убрано из игры.

Как сообщает TheGamePost, Джош Дин ответил игрокам в X, отметив, что команда «планирует выпустить обновление» о процессе разблокировки контента на следующей неделе. В предыдущем посте он признал, что у сообщества могут возникнуть вопросы о разблокировке, потенциальных будущих обновлениях Destiny 2 и о том, что ждёт франшизу в целом.

По словам Дина, процесс будет «очень продуманным», а о первом этапе расскажут ближе к концу октября. Он также уточнил, что предстоящее обновление не будет традиционной дорожной картой — вместо этого информацию представят в виде «индикатора прогресса». Цель — приблизить сообщество к этапам разработки, чётко обозначить возникающие проблемы и предоставить игрокам наглядные доказательства проделанной работы.

Точную дату публикации сообщения Джош Дин не назвал.

newsitems.title: В Dota 2 добавили сокровищницу Trove of Terror - новая аркана на Tidehunter и возвращение арканы Drow Ranger
newsitems.contents:
В Dota 2 вышла сокровищница Trove of Terror. Она принесла 19 косметических предметов, включая 15 наборов уровня Immortal и две арканы — для Drow Ranger и Tidehunter.

Разработчики также добавили механику, снижающую риск неудачных открытий. Обе арканы гарантированно выпадут на 50-м сундуке, а на 12-м и 40-м игрок получит дополнительные награды — облики для Терзателя и Рошана. Одна сокровищница стоит 424 рубля.

Кроме аркан, в набор вошли скины для Tiny, Marci, Treant Protector, Terrorblade, Oracle, Primal Beast, Ancient Apparition, Broodmother, Anti-Mage, Undying, Pudge и Death Prophet.

Ранее, 15 сентября, в Dota 2 вышел патч 7.41f, где разработчики скорректировали баланс героев и предметов.

newsitems.title: Inside the Trove of Terror
newsitems.author: eugenep
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/44e04da47da8b634dee235756e4ffa1234879b40.png"][/img][/p][p]Some time ago, a time now none of us can quite recall, we began to set our minds on matters of the monstrous. Our work has always concerned itself with the manufacture of frightening things, so there was no reason at that time for alarm.[/p][p]Until we began to fill a new treasure chest with item sets themed around eldritch and otherworldly designs.[/p][p]As each horrific creation took more defined shape, unsettling yet tantalizing inspirations took hold of us. Fantastical and Immortal glamours coalesced around each and every set; they grew more spellbinding, a vision that would remain, stuck fast in the mind's eye. Thoughts of monsters birthed thoughts of even more monstrous monsters. Our minds became gateways for greater abominations still, our hands became not our own.[/p][p]Soon our collection of new item sets numbered fifteen, eldritch abominations from the realm of nightmare all. We knew each thing was hideous. Not one of us could look away. Not one of us was content to stop there.[/p][p]To master horrors, we required greater horrors... We required ARCANA.[/p][p]Our first attempt summoned the haunting shape of a Drow Ranger Arcana long thought lost to the flow of time. By some trick of the mind, she can look as she once did or assume a grave-stalking new form.[/p][p]Our appetites remained unsatisfied.[/p][p]Our second attempt unleashed something none of us had ever seen, something that hungrily emerged from a bloodstained sea: the all-new Maw of the Megalodon Arcana for the creature called Tidehunter, arriving with a new model, a host of custom animations, effects, taunts, voice lines, and dragging a familiar-looking corpse that serves as one part security blanket and one part snack. A whisper in the darkness, instructing, teasing: "Should one master this Arcana's secrets, one would surely unlock all three of its shark-toothed designs."[/p][p]This Trove is a doorway to things we cannot explain, let alone understand. The more of these treasures that you open, the more your own minds shine out like beacons to things lurking beyond the limits of reason. Open enough treasures and you're guaranteed to attract the gaze of an all-seeing new Tormentor. Open a number more and you'll surely summon the face of eldritch terror itself, manifesting as an incomprehensible new design for Roshan.[/p][p]We must part now with one final revelation. Take it as a warning if you wish. We didn't make this treasure... It made itself. We thought we were creating something, but we were not. We were merely the conduit, unknowingly letting something into our world from the great dark beyond: The Trove of Terror — overflowing with a mind-bending number of Immortal item sets, one new and one returning Arcana, and brand-new Tormentor and Roshan appearances — available now.[/p][p]If you dare, all you need to do is launch Dota to learn more.[/p]

newsitems.title: The International 2026 Grand Champions
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/bab4343d906943ef2117ae553347d8f8991ebca3.png"][/img]Congratulations to Team Spirit, Grand Champions at The International 2026. After enduring a challenging year, Team Spirit regained their ultimate form just in time to take a five-game Grand Finals slugfest and claim the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai.[/p][p]Spirit's Group Stage started strong, with 2-0 victories over both Xtreme Gaming and Aurora Gaming. They followed with 2-1 win over Team Liquid that put Spirit just one series win away from qualifying for the main stage. They wouldn't get it. Instead, they served as a stepping stone. First to Team Vision, who dropped Spirit in just two games to secure their own invite to the arena. Next, Nigma Galaxy followed suit, handing Spirit another 0-2 loss to snatch a spot on the main stage and force Spirit into elimination play.[/p][p]Their elimination-round opponent? A scrappy Team Resilience who, despite their lower spot in the standings, had clawed out at least one victory in every series they'd played. This round would be no different. Team Spirit took game one with ease, but Resilience rebounded to force a win-or-go-home game three. There, Team Resilience managed to keep pace for a while, until Spirit pulled away in the back half of the match to secure their spot at The International Main Event.[/p][p]The first obstacle at the arena would be the dangerous Iron Wing -- who'd already taken Group Stage series wins off three teams who'd reached the main stage. It wouldn't matter. Team Spirit clipped Iron Wing to send them spiraling into the Lower Bracket and eventual elimination.[/p][p]The next series wouldn't net Spirit the same results. Team Vision, the foe that had already denied them an easy path to the Playoffs, was waiting for them once more. And the result was mostly the same -- Spirit lost. This time 1-2. This time falling into the Lower Bracket, where Team Liquid was already waiting after eliminating last year's champions. Liquid had a stellar showing in the groups, dropping only one series. But that loss came to this same Team Spirit squad they were again facing, and now Team Spirit wouldn't concede even one game.[/p][p]Spirit flushed Liquid out of the tournament to begin an undefeated run through the Lower Bracket, next bouncing both BoomBoys and Team Yandex with 2-0 statements to reach the Grand Finals against -- who else -- Team Vision, the front-runners that had been blocking Spirit's path every step of the way. The team that had stopped Spirit from skipping the elimination round. That had dropped them into the Lower Bracket to fight for their lives. The team that hadn't lost a single series in Shanghai... was now the one thing standing between Team Spirit and the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Game one was Team Spirit all the way. They looked to be cruising to victory in game two as well, but Vision had other plans, clawing back to even the series at one game apiece. It seemed that Vision might steal the momentum by snatching game three, but Spirit held firm to retake the series lead 2-1, just one win away from the Aegis. Once again, Vision would deny them. Their steady play in game four left no room for doubt -- this series was bound for a winner-take-all game five. And it didn't disappoint.[/p][p]After an hour-long showdown that was still anyone's game until the very end, Team Spirit finally overcame the team that had tormented them throughout the tournament, claiming the Aegis of Champions and crowning themselves the very best Dota team in the world. Three-time winners Yatoro and Collapse, and two-time winner Larl now welcome their teammates not_me and rue into an immortal pantheon.[/p][p]As bearers of the ultimate symbol of victory, these names shall forever be inscribed upon the Aegis of Champions:[/p][p][/p][p][b]2026 - Team Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]Illia "Yatoro" Muliarchuk[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Denis "Larl" Sigitov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Magomed "Collapse" Khalilov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexey "not_me" Kosmynin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexander "rue" Filin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/55481652342_4378ab4bed_6k.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Until Next Time[/h3][p]If you missed any of the broadcast, or just want to rewatch some of the iconic plays, head over to the [url="https://www.youtube.com/user/dota2"]Dota 2 YouTube channel[/url], where you'll find replays of the entire show. You can also find a collection of photos from the event over on the [url="https://www.instagram.com/dota2/"]Dota 2 Instagram[/url] and even more hi-res shots on our [url="https://www.flickr.com/photos/dota2ti/"]Dota 2 flickr[/url].  As always, we'd like to thank all of the players, talent, and everyone in the Dota community for helping bring this global celebration to life. We've been honored to once again help shepherd this event to the stage, but it wouldn't be what it is without all of you.[/p]
